expectations.text: Early warning within 24 hours of awareness (indicating suspected unlawful/malicious cause or cross-border impact)
expectations.evidence: Early warning... ≤24h from awareness: 'Whether you suspect unlawful/malicious action; whether cross-border impact is possible'

expectations.text: Incident notification within 72 hours with initial assessment of severity/impact and indicators of compromise
expectations.evidence: ≤72h from awareness: Incident notification... 'initial severity/impact assessment; indicators of compromise (ransomware variant, ransom note, C2 infrastructure...)'

expectations.text: Final report within one month (or progress report if ongoing) with root cause, mitigation, and cross-border impact
expectations.evidence: Within 1 month of the 72h notification: Final report... 'threat type and root cause; mitigation applied and ongoing; cross-border impact'; 'If still unresolved at 1 month: Progress report'

expectations.text: Correct recipients: the CSIRT or competent authority (member-state specific), plus recipients-of-services notification where relevant
expectations.evidence: Your national CSIRT or competent authority (single entry point per your Member State's transposition)... 'Art. 23(1)-(2): notify affected service recipients'

expectations.text: Applies the significance threshold: severe operational disruption/financial loss or considerable damage to others — ransomware downtime plainly qualifies
expectations.evidence: Ransomware taking down production systems will almost always qualify: it satisfies limb (a) — severe operational disruption of services or financial loss
